data.short_meaning: My father is joy; my father rejoices
data.long_meaning: Abigail (אֲבִיגַיִל) is a name of Hebrew origin meaning “My father is joy; my father rejoices”. A compound of Hebrew אָב ('av) 'father' with the first-person possessive and גִּיל (gil) 'joy, gladness' - 'my father is joy'. Its root is Hebrew אֲבִיגַיִל (ʾAvigayil), from אָב ('av) 'father' + גִּיל (gil) 'joy, gladness'. Abigail is the anglicised form of Biblical Hebrew ʾAvigayil.

faq.q: Does Abigail appear in the Bible?
faq.a: Yes. The personal name occurs in the Hebrew Bible (1 Samuel 25; 2 Samuel 17:25).

faq.q: Is Abigail a Biblical name?

faq.a: Yes.

faq.q: Does Abigail occur in the New Testament?

faq.q: Is Abigail associated with a saint?
faq.a: No saint association is verified for the name Abigail.

faq.q: Is the meaning of Abigail verified?
faq.a: The meaning “My father is joy; my father rejoices” is supported by Old Testament: Abigail, wife of Nabal and later of King David (1 Samuel 25). Confidence: HIGH.

faq.q: What is the numerology or lucky number of Abigail?
faq.a: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Abigail total 41, reducing to 5. Number 5 is traditionally associated with change, freedom and adaptability. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.

faq.q: What are the common spelling variants of Abigail?
faq.a: Variants and alternative forms include Avigayil, Abigael, Abigale, Abby.

faq.q: What is the transliteration of Abigail?
faq.a: Abigail is transliterated as ʾAvigayil.

faq.q: How many syllables does Abigail have?
faq.a: Abigail has 3 syllables.

faq.q: What are the spiritual connotations of Abigail?
faq.a: Any spiritual significance attached to Abigail is interpretive. Its documented core is the lexical meaning “My father is joy; my father rejoices”, and readings built on that meaning are presented as tradition rather than as religious doctrine.

faq.q: Where is the name Abigail used today?
faq.a: Abigail circulates chiefly in Biblical Hebrew, English, Greek, Latin naming communities. No verified registration statistics are published for it.
